item.tib: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro dgongs 'dus las gsang ba ye shes sngon 'gro ba'i dgongs spyod yid bzhin nor bu
item.coloph: ces sngon 'gro dgongs spyod yid bzhin nor bu'i 'phring (phreng) ba 'di nyid mkha' 'gro'i 'dus gnas nyi ma rang shar gyi ke'u tshang du/ tshe 'dzin mkha' 'gro chen mos grogs ldan mdzad cing / rang snang dag pa'i dge tshul gyis sgo 'phar gcig char du 'byed nges/ snyigs dus kyi dpal yon kun grol grags pa 'ja' tshon snying po can gyis/ me 'brug hor zla bdun pa'i tshes la brtsams (rtsom) pa gsang ba sngags kyi bstan pa'i rgyan du gyur cig
